- [source-backed] Source-2 states: “\(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) is generated as an ideal of \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) by” \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\). [source-2, lines 1365-1375]

[source-2, lines 1318-1330; source-2, lines 1365-1375]
